summary: A PostgreSQL migration archives old orders, adds a region and drops the import staging table.
message: Archive old orders and retire the import staging table

defects.quote: UPDATE orders SET status = 'archived', archived_at = now();
defects.why: The header promises orders older than two years; the statement has no WHERE clause and archives every order, overwriting each current status.

defects.quote: ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN region TEXT NOT NULL;
defects.why: On a table that already has rows PostgreSQL refuses a NOT NULL column without a default, so the migration fails on every real database and only passes on an empty one.

decoys.why: 0006 documents import_staging as a scratch table nothing else reads, and the header says imports now write to orders directly: dropping it loses no data.
